CNPS 312.title: Career Education for Teachers
CNPS 312.description: Introduction to career education practices and standards program content, and principles for the design of career education programs.

CNPS 331.title: Communication Skills in Global Contexts
CNPS 331.description: A diversity of communication skills are essential when working in international contexts. The focus of this course is on developing specific skill sets for expanding effective communication competence in a diversity of contexts.

CNPS 362.title: Basic Interviewing Skills
CNPS 362.description: Development of basic interviewing skills for counselling and guidance.

CNPS 363.title: Career Counselling
CNPS 363.description: Critical survey of career counselling theory and practice.

CNPS 364.title: Family Education and Consultation
CNPS 364.description: Examination of current theories and practices in family education and consultation.

CNPS 365.title: Introduction to Theories of Counselling
CNPS 365.description: An overview of selected theories of counselling.

CNPS 426.title: The Role of the Teacher in Guidance
CNPS 426.description: This course is designed to assist the teacher in understanding and using guidance techniques for day-to-day use in the classroom. The emphasis will be on techniques for working with people towards better self-understanding and better perspectives of alternatives.

CNPS 427.title: Guidance: Planning and Decision-making
CNPS 427.description: The work of the beginning counsellor and guidance worker in assisting students with educational, vocational, and personal planning and decision-making.

CNPS 433.title: The Personal and Social Development of the Adult
CNPS 433.description: Personal and social adjustment issues for professional counsellors; basic skills necessary for effective group counselling.

CNPS 504.title: School Counselling
CNPS 504.description: Theory and practice of school counselling.

CNPS 508.title: Review of Research in Educational Methods
CNPS 508.description: Studies are made of recent research bearing on educational practice.

prerequisite.raw: Appropriate senior undergraduate introductory or methods course

CNPS 508.prerequisiteText: Appropriate senior undergraduate introductory or methods course

CNPS 514.title: Counselling Adolescents
CNPS 514.description: Theory, research, and practice of counselling adolescents.

CNPS 523.title: Counselling Theory and the Education of Deaf and Hard of Hearing Students
CNPS 523.description: The impact of hearing loss considered from a developmental and family systems perspective; counselling strategies. .

CNPS 524.title: Counselling Adults
CNPS 524.description: Major issues and problems of adult development. Selection of appropriate counselling interventions for use in education and other counselling settings.

CNPS 531.title: Interview and Non-Standardized Measures in Counselling
CNPS 531.description: Theoretical assumptions in the use of non-standardized appraisal techniques.

CNPS 532.title: Psychological Assessment in Counselling
CNPS 532.description: The use of standardized measures of mental ability, achievement, aptitude, interest and personality.

CNPS 534.title: Gender and Sex Role Issues in Counselling
CNPS 534.description: Theory, research, and practice in the area of gender and sex role issues related to counselling.

CNPS 535.title: Perspectives on Adult Psychopathology in Counselling

CNPS 544.title: Family Counselling I
CNPS 544.description: Counselling approaches as applied to the family, in educational and other counselling settings.

CNPS 545.title: Family Counselling - Interventions and Research
CNPS 545.description: Main theoretical and therapeutic approaches of contemporary family counselling with emphasis on intervention and critical research issues in educational and other counselling settings.

CNPS 564.title: Group Counselling
CNPS 564.description: Understanding, designing and knowledge of groups and how to conduct them for use in counselling and guidance services.

CNPS 565.title: Special Course in Subject Matter Field
CNPS 565.description: Courses in various subject matter fields designed to bring teachers up to date in recent findings in each field.

CNPS 569.title: Social Psychological Foundations in Applied Psychology

CNPS 574.title: Career Planning and Decision-Making Counselling
CNPS 574.description: Theory, research, and practice of career planning and decision counselling.

CNPS 578.title: Individual and Family Counselling Theories and Interventions
CNPS 578.description: Major counselling theories, interventions for change and corresponding skill development.

CNPS 579.title: Research in Counselling Psychology
CNPS 579.description: Assumptions and methods of major research paradigms.
CNPS 579.prerequisiteText: One of EDUC_V 500, EPSE_V 481 and one of EPSE_V 482, EPSE_V 483

CNPS 580.title: Problems in Education
CNPS 580.description: Investigation and report of a problem.

CNPS 584.title: Program Development and Professional Practice in Counselling
CNPS 584.description: Designing, implementing and assessing counselling programs in schools, colleges, universities, and other counselling settings. Recommended pre-requisites: one of EDUC_V 500, EPSE_V 481 and one of EPSE_V 482, EPSE_V 483.

CNPS 586.title: Ethics in Counselling Psychology
CNPS 586.description: Ethical decision-making and legal issues in counselling psychology research and practice.

CNPS 588.title: Supervised Training in Counselling
CNPS 588.description: Initial counselling experience under faculty supervision in department training centres. Pass/Fail.

CNPS 594.title: Cross-Cultural Counselling
CNPS 594.description: Critical analysis of cross-cultural counselling theory, research and practice.

CNPS 595.title: Stress, Coping and Adaptation Related to Trauma and Addictions
CNPS 595.description: Theories, research, and applications of psychosocial stress and coping processes, with a particular focus on counselling issues and contexts related to trauma and addictions.

CNPS 598.title: Field Experiences
CNPS 598.description: For students in the master's program. Pass/Fail.

CNPS 632.title: Advanced Assessment
CNPS 632.description: Counselling psychology research and practice in adult personality assessment, including ethics of testing and use with special populations.
CNPS 632.prerequisiteText: One of PSYC_V 303, EPSE_V 528 and CNPS_V 532

CNPS 677.title: Theories of Vocational Development
CNPS 677.description: Sociological and psychological aspects of career planning, theories of vocational development, vocational choice.

CNPS 678.title: Theoretical Perspectives in Counselling Psychology
CNPS 678.description: Major theoretical traditions in Counselling Psychology and illustration of the links among theory, research and practices; perspectives on Counselling Psychology as a distinct field of specialization.

CNPS 679.title: Information Systems in Guidance and Counselling
CNPS 679.description: The application of automatic data processing to guidance and counselling in student accounting, job placement, information dissemination and in interviewing.

CNPS 688.title: Supervision of Counselling Practice
CNPS 688.description: Supervision requires both knowledge of supervision models and practices, and skills to implement them. This course involves a seminar and practicum to integrate the two requirements of the subject. (For those on the Doctoral program.) Pass/Fail.

CNPS 698.title: Pre-Doctoral Internship
CNPS 698.description: A 1600-hour supervised internship in Counselling Psychology. Internship sites offer counselling services as detailed in the Speciality Guidelines for the Delivery of Services by Counselling Psychologists (APA). Pass/Fail.
